title: Three Autumns and One Short Bridge
subtitle: 城市生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）
meta: 主题语境：城市生活（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·城市生活）　|　核心词汇：hometown　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 hometown 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1981 the planner ① rebuilt the hometown that no resident in the town would have described, and he said the rebuilding was the whole of the autumn. The ② hometown, meaning the place itself and not the bridge, ran three autumns and stayed undescribed in the book; a hometown, he said, is the only thing in a town that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ hometown in that town had the same short bridge beside it, and the ④ hometown at the far market, meaning the street they kept for the children to walk and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A hometown, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the planner said the describing is the part that fills three autumns.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the hometown was the whole of the matter, meaning the root and not the place. The ⑥ hometown, meaning the root and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; hometown, he said, is either something you rebuild or the only word that means both a place and a root. He said the root is the part they remember.

By 1986 the ⑦ hometown had become a line in a album, and the album had become an argument about the short bridge. The ⑧ hometown of the whole thing, the planner wrote in September, was one town and three autumns of describing; hometown, he said, is either the street at the far market or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ hometown I remember is the place described in the album, which closed in 1988 and is still described as the quietest in the town. A ⑩ hometown, my mother said in 1990, is the only place that improves by being described; every hometown, she said, is a root that has agreed to look like a place. She said the root was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 家乡；故里（指小镇里每一座旁边的那一座）
B. n. 家乡；故里（指那座故地本身，与石桥相对）
C. 固定搭配：rebuild the hometown 重建家乡
D. n. 家乡；故里（指留给孩子们走的那一座）
E. n. 乡事（抽象总称，指一处小镇的家乡之事）
F. n. 家乡；故里（指相册里写到、被记下的的那一座）
G. n. 根脉、来处（指一件事里人人都念却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 来处（抽象总称，指人人都念却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: rebuilt the hometown that no resident in the town would have described
The hometown, meaning the place itself and not the bridge
the hometown at the far market
the hometown was the whole of the matter
the hometown had become a line in a album
The hometown of the whole thing
A hometown, my mother said in 1990

answers.why: rebuild the hometown 意为“重建家乡”，1981 年那位规划员把小镇里没有一位居民肯描述的一座家乡做了一遍。
hometown 意为“家乡；故里”，指那座故地本身而不是石桥，它经过了三个秋天而在簿子上没有被描述。
hometown 意为“家乡；故里”，指小镇里每一座旁边的那一座，每一座旁边都有同一座短短的石桥。
hometown 意为“家乡；故里”，指最远那个集市留给孩子们走的那一座，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
hometown 意为“根脉、来处”，指一件事里人人都念却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这条根脉就是那件事的全部。
hometown 意为“来处”，指人人都念却无人提起的那样东西而不是那座故地，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
hometown 意为“家乡；故里”，指相册里写到、被记下的的那一座，到 1986 年这一座成了相册里的一行。
hometown 意为“乡事”，规划员九月写道，整件事的家乡之事是一处小镇和三个秋天的描述。
hometown 意为“家乡；故里”，我记得的是相册里描述过的那一座，1988 年命名了，至今仍被说成小镇里最安静的一座。
hometown 为抽象总称，母亲 1990 年说，家乡是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的故地。
